messages.author: 3af87e685f64fff3
messages.subject: Disabling alpha change when rendering?
parts:
I'm having a problem where, as an inputSlider is playing/animating through values and the graphs are rendering to update the values, the graphs will go back and forth between ~50% and 100% opacity, depending on whether it's loading or finished loading the updated graphs.  Is there a way to adjust this such that the opacity just stays the same, regardless of whether it's loading or already updated?


Cheers,


Solomon Choe

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Disabling alpha change when rendering?
parts:
Try including this somewhere in your UI:

tags$style(type="text/css", ".recalculating { opacity: 1; }")

That should disable it.
